name: pptx-mcp
description: Free MCP server: read, outline and preview PowerPoint (.pptx) files from any AI agent.

tools.name: pptx_outline
tools.description: Turns a .pptx into a slide-by-slide outline: title, body text and speaker notes, as JSON.

tools.name: pptx_thumbnail
tools.description: Returns the cover thumbnail image that PowerPoint saved inside the .pptx, if there is one.

tools.name: pptx_web_preview
tools.description: Writes a self-contained HTML page previewing the first 5 slides as text cards, ready to share.
